subject: Request: Net60 for pilot + VAT evidence and payment cadence
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire.b@helixtx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Net60 for pilot + VAT evidence and payment cadence

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the Helix team is keen to move forward with the enterprise pilot next month. A few billing asks from procurement so we can issue a PO: 

- Can Redwood accept Net60 for this pilot? Our finance team prefers Net60 on pilot contracts to align with monthly close.
- We need an invoice cadence that maps to our milestone deliverables (monthly invoices tied to usage and one-time onboarding fees).
- Please provide VAT / tax evidence for Redwood's EU entity — procurement needs confirmation for cross-border VAT handling.
- Also confirm whether Redwood can provide a short-term credit limit (requested: $200,000) while we set up the PO and payments.

PO reference (internal): HLX-PO-4521.

If Net60 is not achievable, would Redwood consider a compromise (e.g., Net45 with a partial prepayment)? We can fast-track the PO if we have clarity this week.

Attached: draft SOW (for alignment).

Best,
Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Procurement | Helix Therapeutics
claire.b@helixtx.com
[attachment: SOW_Helix_Redwood_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.b@helixtx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + VAT evidence and payment cadence

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Really excited to get Helix onboard. A couple of notes from our side: 

Short answer: we can be flexible but need to balance credit exposure for pilot customers. Proposed options we can implement quickly: 

1) Preferred compromise (fastest): 30% onboarding deposit + Net30 on subsequent monthly invoices. This gets you operational quickly and reduces our short-term credit risk.

2) Alternate (finance-approved but requires review): Net45 / Net60 on usage invoices with a short-term credit line capped at $125k for the first 60 days while we collect the PO and remit the deposit. We can revisit limits at day 60 once usage patterns are established.

3) If Helix needs Net60 outright with a $200k credit limit, we will require a completed credit application and a 60–90 day finance review before enabling that level.

Action items I recommend now: 
- Helix confirms in writing which option you prefer (1/2/3).
- If option 2 or 3, please complete the attached fillable credit app and provide a VAT certificate for the billing entity.
- If you can sign SOW and issue PO with a 30% deposit (option 1), we can start onboarding immediately and invoice for the deposit on receipt of PO.

I've looped in Monica from Finance to run the credit check and finalize the short-term limit. Marissa will own contract signature questions.

Attaching: SOW (clean copy) and Credit App (fillable).

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[attachment: SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 312 KB)] [attachment: Credit_App_Helix_fillable.pdf (application/pdf, 98 KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + VAT evidence and payment cadence

Ben / Marissa — quick finance readout after reviewing Helix's usage profile and the SOW: 

- Risk tier: Medium. Pilot revenue expected to ramp quickly but initial monthly run-rate low; exposure acceptable with modest deposit.
- Recommendation: Offer Option 2 as the standard for pilots where the customer requests extended terms: Net45 on usage invoices, with a $75k upfront deposit (invoiced on PO) and a temporary credit cushion of $125k for 60 days. After 60 days we will re-evaluate limit based on usage and payment timeliness.
- For Net60 requests (Option 3), require completed credit application + two supplier references and allow 7–10 business days for underwriting; consider partial card-on-file guarantees if Helix prefers no deposit.

We also need the following documents from Helix to finalize: 
- VAT certificate for Helix EU billing entity (PDF)
- Completed Credit_App_Helix_fillable.pdf (I attached a pre-filled form; please verify and return)

Ben — I uploaded the internal credit form and the standard temporary-limit addendum to the deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HLX-ENT-4521. I'll draft the short addendum language and share by EOD.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Finance | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
[attachment: Credit_App_Helix_prefill.pdf (application/pdf, 45 KB)]

From: Claire Bennett <claire.b@helixtx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 for pilot + VAT evidence and payment cadence

Ben / Monica / Marissa — thanks for the quick responses and the clear options. After internal review we'll proceed with Option 2 as you outlined. Confirming: 

- Helix will issue a PO for the pilot (HLX-PO-4521) today.
- We'll provide the VAT certificate for our EU billing entity and a completed credit app by tomorrow morning.
- We agree to a $75,000 upfront deposit (invoice upon PO receipt) and the temporary $125,000 credit cushion for 60 days, with a re-evaluation at day 60.

Please send the deposit invoice to accounting@helixtx.com and include payment instructions (wire / ACH details). Once we have the invoice we will route payment; anticipated payment date Sep 15.

Attached: VAT_certificate_Helix_2026.pdf (scanned).

Looking forward to a smooth onboarding.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Procurement | Helix Therapeutics
claire.b@helixtx.com
[attachment: VAT_certificate_Helix_2026.pdf (image/pdf, 220 KB)]
